segments.title: 5. Setup on Windows 10 or Linux (v5)
lines: No programs to install by hand: ffmpeg, COLMAP and Blender are replaced by pip packages or built-in code, and setup installs MediaPipe for you.
setup makes .venv (pip packages), venv_pose (mocap, private Python 3.12 via uv) and downloads the pose model.
Linux only: the visual UI needs Tk  ->  sudo apt install python3-tk

segments.title: What replaced what
lines: ffmpeg  ->  imageio-ffmpeg (pip wheel with ffmpeg inside)
COLMAP  ->  pycolmap (COLMAP as a Python library, CPU)
Blender (FBX)  ->  built-in FBX writer (pure Python, checked in Blender, FBX2glTF, assimp)
MediaPipe setup  ->  done by setup (uv fetches Python 3.12 into python312/)
Still optional from the system: gcc + raylib for the C example, Blender if you prefer its exporter.
